info.title: Home Lab Launcher API
info.description: Pre-1.0 JSON API for the bundled frontend, trusted plugins, and private-deployment automation. Mutating API routes require the session CSRF token in the X-CSRF-Token header, except /api/bootstrap and /api/auth/login. Automation may instead authenticate with an Admin-issued API token via Authorization: Bearer; token requests skip CSRF, act with the token's role, and are rejected on session/profile endpoints (/api/auth/*, /api/me*, /api/bootstrap*).

post.description: Available only while no users exist. CSRF is not required for this bootstrap route.

patch.description: Changing password, resetting TOTP, or changing role revokes target-user sessions. At least one Admin account must remain.

parameters.name: updates
parameters.description: Admins may request update discovery with updates=1.

bearerToken.description: Admin-issued API token (hll_ prefix). Skips CSRF; not accepted on session/profile endpoints.

recoveryCodes.description: Ten single-use codes, shown exactly once.

recoveryCodesRemaining.description: Unused TOTP recovery codes. Present on /api/me when 2FA is enabled.

recoveryCode.description: Single-use recovery code accepted in place of a TOTP code; case and separators are ignored.

health_webhook_url.description: Webhook receiving a JSON POST on service up/down transitions. Empty string disables.

uptime24h.description: Percentage of samples with status=up over the last 24 hours; null without history.

iconImageData.description: Data URL for uploaded icon image.

customUrl.description: Optional service URL override. Required when the selected preset has no website fallback.

tokenPrefix.description: Display prefix of the token for identification; the full secret is never stored.

expiresDays.description: Optional expiry in days from creation.
